newsitem.title: USA: Great Western Financial files $650 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Great Western Financial files $650 mln shelf.

text.p: Two business trusts formed by Great Western Financial Corp said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $650,330,000 in guaranteed and preferred securities.

The trusts, known as Great Western Financial Trust II and Great Western Financial Trust III, will use the proceeds from the sale to invest in senior debt securities and preferred and common stock of the parent.
The parent will in turn use the funds for general corporate purposes, which may include lending and investment activities and repayment or purchase of outstanding debt, the filing said.
Great Western of Chatsworth, Calif., is a savings and loan holding company.
